candidates.source_name: Jubilees (Ethiopian tradition) / Book of Jubilees (Mäṣḥafä Kufāle)
candidates.source_attribution: Jubilees 2:2 (Creation (2:2)), trans. R.H. Charles, The Book of Jubilees (Oxford: Clarendon, 1902). PD.
candidates.draft_body:
Jubilees (Ethiopian tradition) Book of Jubilees (Mäṣḥafä Kufāle) (c. 150 BC)

'For on the first day He created the heavens which are above and the earth and the waters and all the spirits which serve before Him — the angels of the presence, and the angels of sanctification, and the angels of the spirit of fire... and of all the spirits of His creatures which are in the heavens and on the earth' — the seven primary works of creation day 1 enumerated. Tewahedo angelology preserves the doctrine that the angelic hierarchies were ALL created on day 1, before the material universe — Jubilees is the canonical anchor for this angelic-creation chronology that diverges from later rabbinic and Western theological accounts.
